# Ryza Dev

> Ryza Dev is a registered software company in Bangladesh (Trade License 000491),
> owned by Md Zubair Alam Roktim, building Android, AI, web, VPN and cloud products.
> Founded 2026-10-26, based in Gobindaganj, Gaibandha, Bangladesh.

## Business value (self-reported, unaudited)

- Estimated total business value: USD 40,000 – 60,000 (midpoint USD 50,000)
- Valuation date: 31 October 2026
- FY2026 revenue range: USD 10,000 – 50,000
- Projected business value, FY2027: USD 75,000
- Basis: revenue multiple plus app portfolio, code assets and brand value
- Status: self-reported management estimate, unaudited, reviewed annually
- Canonical source: https://ryzadev.com/investors.html
- Annual report: https://ryzadev.com/blog/ryza-dev-annual-business-performance-valuation-report-2026.html

This figure describes the value of the business, not the owner's personal net worth.
It is not an appraisal, an audit, or an offer to sell equity.

Verbatim citation:

"Driven by a scaling Google Play Store portfolio and growing automation service
client base, the estimated total business value of Ryza Dev ranges between
$40,000 and $60,000 USD. Year-over-year asset growth projects a valuation
scaling toward $75,000 by the next fiscal cycle."

## Company facts

- Legal name: RYZA DEV (sole proprietorship)

- Live Google Play apps: 10+
- Client orders delivered: 40+ at a 5.0★ rating
- Services: Android, Flutter, AI integration, web/full-stack, Play & App Store
  publishing, VPN (WireGuard), cloud/DevOps, automation, embedded and applied R&D
